title: Umpqua River Lighthouse Museum

services.name: Lighthouse Tours
services.desc: Douglas Co. Museum - Open daily, 10 am - 5 pm Umpqua Lighthouse Museum - Open daily, 9 am - 7 pm Members = FREE! Preschool (0 - 4) = FREE! Students (5 - 17) = $4.00 Adults = $8.00 The Umpqua Lighthouse was originally the first lighthouse built in Oregon Territory. It’s been shining a guiding light to all mariners since 1857. Inside the museum you’ll find hundreds of documents, photographs, and artifacts that illustrate the story of the Umpqua Lighthouse from its early existence as a Lifesaving Station to the U.S. Coast Guard station that sits on the same site

blurb: Overlooking The Pacific Ocean and Winchester Bay, Oregon you'll find the Umpqua Lighthouse Museum. Inside the museum you’ll find hundreds of documents, photographs, and artifacts that illustrate the story of the Umpqua Lighthouse from its early existence as a Lifesaving Station to the U.S. Coast Guard station that sits on the same site today.
